item.title: ARREST/FIRE REPORT November 26, 2025
item.description: Crookston Fire Calls Fire Report TUESDAY, NOVEMBER 25At 3:15 pm, the Crookston fire department responded to a motor vehicle accident on the 400th block of Washington. They performed a standard battery disconnect on scene, before turning it over to law enforcement and the towing company.

item.title: Highland and Washington School students log over 4,000 hours of readering
item.description: The success of parents, teachers and students working together was shown in the November 10-21 Read-A-Thon held at the Highland Elementary School and Washington Early Childhood School in Crookston.
